1.0.2.title: Aprimoramentos de diagnóstico e confiabilidade.
1.0.2.summary: Esta atualização reúne melhorias no tratamento das mensagens de diagnóstico do runtime da API Anivexa e ajustes técnicos nos fluxos internos da aplicação.

highlights.title: Diagnósticos do runtime Anivexa
highlights.description: Mensagens técnicas passaram a ser tratadas de forma mais controlada e concisa.

highlights.title: Aprimoramentos internos
highlights.description: A versão inclui ajustes técnicos nos fluxos internos relacionados à conta.

githubRelease.summary: Patch release focused on Anivexa runtime diagnostics, account-sync IPC validation, and a more verifiable Windows release process.

sections.title: Anivexa runtime diagnostics
details: Sanitized API error summaries continue through the diagnostics channel, while stderr receives a fixed redacted message instead of the original `console.error` arguments.

sections.title: Account synchronization IPC
details: Watch-later upserts validate anime IDs, title shape, optional fields, episode counts, release dates, genres, and timestamps before reaching the account service.
Episode-progress upserts validate identifiers, non-negative episode numbers, finite time values, positive durations, and that current playback time does not exceed duration.

sections.title: Windows packaging and release workflow
details: The application root MIT license is included as a packaged resource.
The package verifier checks the Setup installer, full Squirrel `.nupkg`, executable identity, required Anivexa runtime files and revision, package manifest, and `RELEASES` hash and size.

Development CI runs Linux quality checks in one job and builds the Windows package only for a `dev`-to-`main` promotion pull request. The manual stable-release workflow builds the exact tag and creates a draft with the installer, full `.nupkg`, and `RELEASES` already attached.
